description: This file contains utility functions for processing polylines in Leaflet, including simplification, distance calculations, segment clipping, and related geometric operations.

methods.name: simplify
methods.description: Simplifies a polyline by reducing vertices using vertex reduction and Douglas-Peucker algorithm for performance optimization.

methods.name: pointToSegmentDistance
methods.description: Calculates the distance from a point to a line segment.

methods.name: closestPointOnSegment
methods.description: Finds the closest point on a segment to a given point.

methods.name: clipSegment
methods.description: Clips a line segment to a rectangular bounds using Cohen-Sutherland algorithm.

methods.name: _getEdgeIntersection
methods.description: Calculates the intersection point of a segment with a rectangle edge based on Cohen-Sutherland codes.

methods.name: _getBitCode
methods.description: Generates Cohen-Sutherland outcode for a point relative to bounds.

methods.name: _sqClosestPointOnSegment
methods.description: Calculates the squared closest point on a segment to a point.

methods.name: isFlat
methods.description: Checks if an array of latlngs is flat (non-nested).
